zone_id.description: The RadioZone this channel belongs to.

number.description: Display order within the zone, e.g. the "3" in "CH 3 - Calling".

moderator_only.description: When true, only moderators/admins may transmit on this channel; anyone with zone access can still listen.

listen_only.description: When true, nobody can transmit on this channel (it carries an audio feed); everyone with zone access can listen.

feed_owner_user_id.description: The member whose audio feed this stream channel carries. They (and admins) may connect a feed to it.

admin_only.description: When true, only admins may join this channel at all (listen or transmit).

max_users.description: Optional cap on simultaneous listeners/participants. Blank/0 means unlimited.
